data: Which algorithm has the highest precision when recall is close to 0.9 on the GDS dataset?

The question asks for the algorithm with the highest precision when recall is close to 0.9 on the GDS dataset. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the Precision-Recall curves of different algorithms on both NYT and GDS datasets. 

Looking at the right graph (b), which represents the PR curve on the GDS dataset, we can see multiple lines representing different algorithms. We need to identify the line that reaches the highest precision value near the point where recall is approximately 0.9.

Upon analyzing the graph, the red line labeled "PA-TMR" appears to have the highest precision value among all the lines when recall is close to 0.9. Therefore, the algorithm with the highest precision when recall is close to 0.9 on the GDS dataset is PA-TMR.
